auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT T1.Diagnosis, T2.Year, T2.Month, T2.Day
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
JOIN laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.ID = 30609
